verdict.rationale: Waiting for a selector is a fair capability to ask of a JS-rendering scraping API, so the axis applies. The evidence shows Firecrawl handles JS-heavy pages (firecrawl-gh-8), supports post-scrape interactions such as clicking and filling forms (firecrawl-docs-3), and offers managed browser sessions (firecrawl-docs-8). Nothing in the pack documents a wait-for-selector parameter or action before the rendered page is returned.
